name: Option Care Health
reason: Home infusion with thin 6.0% EBIT margin, share count up 25%/yr from the BioScrip merger and earnings exposed to payer reimbursement and drug-mix (biosimilar) shifts - ordinary, not special.

name: OPENLANE
reason: Wholesale used-car marketplace plus floorplan lending; EBIT margin at 10y high (16.7%), net debt/EBITDA 5.2x on finance book, adj-vs-GAAP gap ~246% and P/E 22x - cycle and credit exposure too hard to forecast.

name: OSI Systems
reason: Strong 17% 10y EPS CAGR but growth leans on lumpy government/turnkey security contracts (large single-country awards) and FCF conversion only 0.8x with working-capital build - durability hard to underwrite.

name: Otis Worldwide
reason: Global elevator oligopoly whose ~60%-of-sales service portfolio is a recurring annuity; ROIC ~58%, FCF conversion 1.2x, minimal M&A, net debt/EBITDA 2.9x and consensus FY2-3 EPS growth ~11-12% despite China new-equipment weakness.

name: Otter Tail
reason: EPS tripled since 2020 on a PVC-pipe pricing boom (EBIT margin 26% vs 14% pre-2021) and consensus now falls -14%/-23% in FY2-3 - commodity plastics earnings at a cyclical peak bolted onto a slow-growth utility.

name: OUTFRONT Media
reason: Billboard/transit REIT with net debt/EBITDA 8.6x, FFO flat over 10y (1.99 in 2015 vs 2.00 in 2025) and ad-cycle-driven revenue - fails balance sheet and growth tests.

name: PACS Group
reason: Skilled-nursing operator with net debt/EBITDA 9.2x, EPS collapsing from 6.11 to 0.36 amid Medicare billing investigation and government reimbursement dependence.

name: Penske Automotive
reason: Auto dealer whose EPS (13.33) is still 2x pre-COVID on inflated vehicle margins now normalising (-15% in 2024), net debt/EBITDA 6.8x incl. floorplan and consensus FY1-3 growth 0-7% - cyclical, not special.

name: Plains GP Holdings
reason: Crude/NGL midstream GP with earnings tied to commodity spreads and volumes, 10y EPS CAGR -0.8%, shares up 10.8%/yr and net debt/EBITDA 4.7x.

name: Paycom Software
reason: High-quality HCM software (ROIC ~32%, net cash) but revenue growth has decelerated sharply, EBIT margin swung 33.7% to 27.6% as Beti cannibalised fees, and float income is rate-sensitive - long-run growth path too uncertain.

name: Paychex
reason: SMB payroll/HR franchise with 43% EBIT margin, ROIC ~34%, EPS up every year incl. 2020 (10.4% 10y CAGR), FCF conversion 1.08x and net debt/EBITDA 1.1x; consensus ~7-8% EPS growth after Paycor deal - watch margin at 10y high and float-rate sensitivity.

name: PACCAR
reason: Best-in-class truck OEM but earnings are set by the Class 8 cycle (EPS 9.61 in 2023 to 5.01 in 2025, 0.52x peak) plus 2027 emissions pre-buy timing - cannot forecast 5-10y EPS with confidence.

name: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust
reason: Urban hotel REIT with FFO 1.58 vs 2.50 in 2015, net debt/EBITDA 7.7x and highly cyclical travel demand - fails growth and balance sheet tests.

name: Public Service Enterprise Group
reason: Regulated NJ utility plus merchant nuclear with only 3.4% 10y EPS CAGR (1/10 years >=7%), negative FCF and net debt/EBITDA 5.3x - fails the 7% growth test.

name: PepsiCo
reason: Great brands but 10y EPS CAGR 5.9%, consensus FY1-3 growth only 2-5% and snack volumes face a credible GLP-1 headwind - no plausible route to >=7%/yr.

name: Performance Food Group
reason: 1.4% EBIT margin distributor whose growth came from acquisitions (acq/FCF 1.9x, shares +4.8%/yr) with net debt/EBITDA 4.4x and adj-vs-GAAP gap ~112%.

name: Progyny
reason: Asset-light fertility benefits manager with net cash but short public history, employer-client concentration (large client losses in 2024) and benefit-design/regulatory uncertainty make 5-10y forecasting hard.

name: Phathom Pharmaceuticals
reason: Single-product biotech (vonoprazan) still loss-making with EBIT margin -91%, negative FCF and binary commercial/patent outcomes.

name: Polaris
reason: Discretionary powersports OEM with EPS collapsing from 10.40 (2022) to -0.01 (2025), margin in bottom decile and net debt/EBITDA 5.8x - cyclical with weak balance sheet.

name: PJT Partners
reason: Advisory boutique whose earnings depend on M&A/restructuring/capital-markets activity (EPS at 10y high, margin 82nd pctile) - unforecastable by rule.
